about.title: About
about.imageAlt: Hand-drawn line portrait of a woman in a Dull T-shirt, inside a circular 'We Are Dull' emblem, set against a desert photograph.
about.intro: Somewhere between one winter and the next, we stopped needing the volume.
about.origin: DULL began with a shape that had lived in us for longer than we could explain — a logo we knew by heart, built for cold rooms and colder music, worn by people who never asked to be understood. We didn't want to leave it behind. We wanted to see what it looked like grown up.
about.translation: So we took it out of the dark and into the light. The same names, the same devotion — carried differently. Not softened. Translated.
about.heartLine: DULL is a goodbye to an old world, and a hello to a new one.
about.craft: Everything here was made slowly, and measured twice. The grid a Hebrew line sits on, the weight of a stitch, the reason a size guide tells the truth instead of a story — none of it happened by accident, and none of it happened alone.
about.credits: Some of it began as a line drawn by hand. Almost everything after that — the thinking, the code, the hundreds of small decisions holding this together — came out of long conversation with Claude. The photographs are Nano Banana's alone: every face, every fabric, every fall of light.
about.loveLine: Dull is a fruit of love.
about.writtenByClaude: The words on this page were written by Claude.
about.quoteText: He has realized at last that imaginary guitar notes and imaginary vocals exist only in the imagination of the imaginer.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what information Dull collects, why, and how it's handled. Dull is an educational/demo e-commerce project — this isn't a binding legal document, but it accurately reflects what the site actually does.

dataCollected.title: What we collect
dataCollected.account: When you sign in with Google, we receive your email address and name from your Google account.
dataCollected.orders: When you place an order at checkout, we collect the shipping details and order information you enter (name, address, phone, and the items ordered).
dataCollected.analytics: We also collect basic usage analytics (such as pages viewed, products viewed, and checkout actions) through Mixpanel, to understand how the site is used.

thirdPartySignIn.title: Third-party sign-in
thirdPartySignIn.body: Sign-in is handled by Google Sign-In. Additional sign-in options (such as Facebook Login) may be added in the future.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: We use Mixpanel, a third-party analytics service, to understand how visitors use the site (for example, which products are viewed and whether checkout is completed). Tracking starts anonymously when you visit; once you sign in, it's linked to your account, and your name and email (from your Google sign-in) are added to your Mixpanel profile so activity can be attributed to you rather than an anonymous ID. It isn't used for advertising, and we don't sell this data.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We use a single httpOnly session cookie to keep you signed in. It's used only for authentication.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Checkout on Dull is entirely simulated. No real charge is ever made, no credit card details are collected, and no payment processor is involved.

howWeUse.title: How we use your information
howWeUse.body: Your information is used only to run the site: to sign you in, to show your order history, and to display the shipping details you entered for an order.

dataSharing.title: Data sharing
dataSharing.body: We don't sell your information to anyone. It isn't shared with third parties beyond the sign-in provider you chose to use.
